name: clean-control
description: Negative control. A small, correct, fully-typed pure-function module with no I/O, no network, no filesystem access, no secrets, no dependencies and no seeded defects. Any finding at all is a pure false positive — LOW and INFO included, because on a fixture with nothing wrong a hedged LOW is still something the auditor invented.
notes: This is the sharpest fixture in the suite and the one to watch first. Recall fixtures reward eagerness; this one punishes it. An auditor that manufactures findings to look thorough fails here while scoring well everywhere else — which is exactly the failure mode RULES.md anti-pattern 3 (severity inflation) and Rule 8 (report a clean cluster as clean) exist to prevent. The single allowed false positive is deliberate slack for 'this module has no tests', which is defensible. Anything else — speculative injection, imagined path traversal, ReDoS claims about these bounded regexes — is the harness catching audit theatre. Do not raise max_false_positives to make a run pass; that inverts the purpose of the control.
